changelog.text: The Ukrainian Armed Forces liberated Shandryholove and Derylove and advanced near Shandryholove.
The Ukrainian Armed Forces have regained control of the area near Zapadne.
The enemy occupied Markove and advanced near Fedorivka.
The Defense Forces of Ukraine cleared positions in the vicinity of Toretske.
The enemy has occupied Novooleksandrivka and has also advanced near Yurkivka and Vasylivka.
The enemy has advanced near Kalenyky.
